nodes.name: Claude Code Settings
nodes.summary: Claude Code project settings enabling the understand-anything plugin.

nodes.name: Understand-Anything Ignore Rules
nodes.summary: Gitignore-style exclusion patterns for the understand-anything analysis tool. Most entries are commented out; currently excludes default build artifacts.

nodes.name: Alembic Migration Environment
nodes.summary: Alembic environment configuration that wires async SQLAlchemy engine to the migration runner. Reads DATABASE_URL from settings, loads all models to populate Base.metadata, and supports both offline and online (async) migration modes.

nodes.name: Alembic Migration Script Template
nodes.summary: Mako template used by Alembic to auto-generate new migration revision files with upgrade() and downgrade() stubs.

nodes.name: Migration: Move Forklift Fields to forklift_specs
nodes.summary: Alembic migration (rev 0b24e4aaa242, parent fbd2d0a45d80) that moves mast_type and max_lift_height_mm columns from the forklifts table into forklift_specs, migrating existing data in-place.

nodes.name: Migration: Initial Schema (55 Tables)
nodes.summary: First Alembic migration (rev 425b763888ef, no parent) that establishes the baseline schema — converts activity_logs.details from TEXT to JSON, adds indexes on activity_logs and leads tables, and updates foreign key constraints.

nodes.name: Migration: Add forklift_specs Table
nodes.summary: Alembic migration (rev fbd2d0a45d80, parent 425b763888ef) that creates the forklift_specs table with tire, battery, and attachment columns, linked to forklifts via CASCADE foreign key.

nodes.name: App Package Init
nodes.summary: Empty package initializer for the backend app module.

nodes.name: Excel Customer Import API
nodes.summary: FastAPI router providing a POST /customers endpoint to bulk-import customers from an uploaded .xlsx/.xls file using pandas. Validates required columns, deduplicates by email, maps status enum values, and returns import statistics.

nodes.name: Core Package Init
nodes.summary: Empty package initializer for the backend core module.

nodes.name: Application Configuration
nodes.summary: Pydantic-settings based configuration for the DK CRM API. Loads from .env and provides defaults for database URL, JWT secret/algorithm/expiry, file upload settings, and CORS allowed origins.

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.summary: Pydantic BaseSettings subclass that centralizes all application configuration: app metadata, DATABASE_URL, JWT parameters (SECRET_KEY, ALGORITHM, expiry times), upload constraints, and CORS origins.

nodes.name: Production HTTP Middleware
nodes.summary: Starlette middleware for security headers (X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, X-XSS-Protection, etc.) and request correlation IDs with per-request timing logs.

nodes.name: SecurityHeadersMiddleware
nodes.summary: BaseHTTPMiddleware that injects hardened HTTP security headers (nosniff, DENY frame, XSS protection, referrer policy, permissions policy, no-store cache) on every response.

nodes.name: RequestIdMiddleware
nodes.summary: BaseHTTPMiddleware that assigns a unique X-Request-ID to each request, measures elapsed time, and emits a structured log line per request.

nodes.name: RBAC Permissions
nodes.summary: Defines the PermissionName enum (28 permissions covering customers, leads, forklifts, quotations, rentals, billing), the ROLE_PERMISSIONS mapping for SUPER_ADMIN/MANAGER/SALES/SUPPORT roles, and the require_permission FastAPI dependency factory.

nodes.name: PermissionName
nodes.summary: String enum defining all 28 fine-grained permissions for the CRM system, covering dashboard, customer, lead, forklift, quotation, rental, and billing operations.

nodes.name: require_permission
nodes.summary: FastAPI dependency factory that returns a Depends checking whether the current user's role includes the specified PermissionName. Superusers bypass all checks; missing/inactive roles and insufficient permissions raise HTTP 403.

nodes.name: Security Utilities (JWT + bcrypt)
nodes.summary: Core security functions: bcrypt password hashing/verification, JWT access token creation (with JTI for revocation), refresh token creation, and token decoding with error normalization.

nodes.name: hash_password
nodes.summary: Hashes a plaintext password using bcrypt with auto-generated salt.

nodes.name: create_access_token
nodes.summary: Creates a signed HS256 JWT access token with sub, exp, type=access, and a unique JTI for revocation tracking.

nodes.name: decode_token
nodes.summary: Decodes and validates a JWT token using the configured SECRET_KEY and ALGORITHM; raises ValueError on invalid/expired tokens.

nodes.name: Database Package Init
nodes.summary: Empty package initializer for the database module.

nodes.name: SQLAlchemy Declarative Base
nodes.summary: Defines the single SQLAlchemy DeclarativeBase subclass (Base) shared by all ORM models in the application.

nodes.name: Base
nodes.summary: SQLAlchemy DeclarativeBase subclass used as the parent for every ORM model in the DK CRM, enabling shared metadata and table registry.

nodes.name: Database Module (Empty)
nodes.summary: Empty placeholder file in the database package.

nodes.name: Async Database Session Factory
nodes.summary: Creates the async SQLAlchemy engine (with SQLite and PostgreSQL-specific pool configuration), the AsyncSessionLocal session maker, and the get_db dependency generator used throughout the API.

nodes.name: get_db
nodes.summary: Async generator FastAPI dependency that yields an AsyncSession and automatically rolls back on exceptions.

nodes.name: FastAPI Auth Dependencies
nodes.summary: Provides get_current_user (validates Bearer JWT, checks JTI revocation list, loads active User) and get_current_superuser (enforces is_superuser flag) FastAPI dependencies.

nodes.name: get_current_user
nodes.summary: FastAPI dependency that extracts and validates a Bearer JWT, checks the JTI against the RevokedToken table, and returns the active User or raises HTTP 401.

nodes.name: get_current_superuser
nodes.summary: FastAPI dependency wrapping get_current_user that additionally enforces is_superuser=True, raising HTTP 403 otherwise.

nodes.name: FastAPI Application Entry Point
nodes.summary: Main FastAPI application: registers lifespan (DB create_all + SQLite idempotent migrations + RBAC seed), adds CORS and custom security/request-id middleware, mounts all API routers under /api/v1, serves static uploads, and provides /health check and global exception handlers.

nodes.name: lifespan
nodes.summary: Async context manager that runs on app startup: executes Base.metadata.create_all, applies idempotent SQLite schema migrations (_apply_sqlite_migrations), seeds RBAC roles, then disposes the engine on shutdown.

nodes.name: health_check
nodes.summary: GET /health endpoint that probes the database with SELECT 1 and returns JSON with status (healthy/degraded), API version, and database reachability.

nodes.name: Debug Activity Script
nodes.summary: One-off debug script that launches uvicorn in a subprocess, logs in as admin, and performs a single GET /api/v1/activity/?limit=5 to inspect activity log responses with server logs visible.

nodes.name: Debug Activity Script 2
nodes.summary: Debug script that replicates a failing test sequence: login, create customer, update customer, create lead, update lead, add note, then fetch activity log — all against a subprocess-managed uvicorn server.

nodes.name: User Serialization Diagnosis Script
nodes.summary: Standalone async diagnostic script that loads the admin user from the database and attempts UserOut.model_validate to isolate Pydantic serialization failures on the User model.

nodes.name: E2E Final Test Suite
nodes.summary: Comprehensive end-to-end test script using httpx against a running API server. Covers authentication, customer CRUD, lead lifecycle/transitions/notes, activity log filtering, report exports (CSV/Excel), token revocation, and edge cases with pass/fail/warn reporting.

nodes.name: E2E Basic Test Script
nodes.summary: Simple end-to-end test script using urllib that starts uvicorn in a subprocess, performs health check, admin login, and GET /users/me validation, then prints full JSON response.
